desktop.clock.attribution: Weather data: Open-Meteo. The free edition is intended for noncommercial use.

desktop.deck.emptyDescription: Select a button to change its image, icon, text, color and action.
desktop.deck.help: Buttons can open web pages and PC apps, send shortcuts to the active window, control music or change the phone view.
desktop.deck.security: Shortcuts and programs run on Windows. Configure only actions you trust.

desktop.settings.backgroundHelp: When you close the window, SpotDock stays connected in the Windows tray.

desktop.settings.languageHelp: Detected on this computer and sent to your phone.

desktop.spotify.description: SpotDock first uses the Windows media session. If Spotify is unavailable there, it can read and control playback through the official API.
desktop.spotify.sessionHelp: Play a song in Spotify and select its session if it is not detected automatically. SpotDock will remember the identifier on this computer.
desktop.spotify.instructionsStart: In Spotify for Developers, create an app and register
